description: This file contains step definitions for Cucumber tests related to client creation in the Fineract project. It handles creating clients with various parameters such as random data, specific names, addresses, and activation dates, and includes assertions for successful creation.

classes.name: ClientStepDef
classes.description: Step definitions for client-related test scenarios, extending AbstractStepDef to utilize shared test context and helper methods.

methods.name: createClientRandomFirstNameLastName
methods.description: Creates a client with randomly generated data using the client factory, sends a request to the API, checks response success, stores response in context, and verifies event emission.

methods.name: createSecondClientRandomFirstNameLastName
methods.description: Creates a second client with random data, similar to the first, and stores the response.

methods.name: createClient
methods.description: Creates a client with specified first and last names, sends request, checks success, and stores response.

methods.name: createClientWithAddress
methods.description: Creates a client with specified names and an address, including generating address related codes, and handles API response and event verification.

methods.name: createClientWithSpecifiedDates
methods.description: Creates a client with a specific activation date, sends request, and verifies success.

methods.name: checkClientCreatedSuccessfully
methods.description: Asserts that the previous client creation response was successful and verifies associated events.
